bounded_host_request.command: docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -A -t -c "SELECT r.room_id,d.revision,d.step,d.data->>'stage',coalesce(t.board_key,'NONE') AS origin_board,coalesce(t.purpose,'NONE') AS origin_purpose,(SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics p WHERE p.chat_id=s.chat_id AND p.message_thread_id=s.message_thread_id AND p.enabled AND p.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND p.purpose IN ('announcement','room')) AS original_routes,(SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics p WHERE p.board_key=t.board_key AND p.chat_id=s.chat_id AND p.message_thread_id=CASE t.board_key WHEN 'area_bbs' THEN 116 WHEN 'video_chat' THEN 1605 WHEN 'gay_board' THEN 4 END AND p.enabled AND p.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND p.purpose IN ('announcement','room')) AS online_routes FROM room_posts r JOIN public_post_drafts d ON d.owner_user_id=r.owner_user_id AND d.module='room' AND d.revision=(substring(r.request_key from '[0-9]+$'))::int LEFT JOIN topic_dm_entry_sessions s ON s.owner_user_id=r.owner_user_id AND s.expires_at>now() LEFT JOIN posting_topics t ON t.chat_id=s.chat_id AND t.message_thread_id=s.message_thread_id AND t.enabled WHERE r.updated_at>=now()-interval '48 hours' ORDER BY r.room_id"
